Compare the allowed CPU set against topology completeness. If any assigned CPU lacks a socket-and-core mapping, reject the coverage claim rather than assigning an inferred identity.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 手算八組兄弟對得到 50%；跨兩個 socket 使用重複 core_id 的邊界測例不得誤合併；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Hand-count the eight sibling pairs to obtain 50% coverage. Add a boundary fixture with repeated core_id numbers on two sockets and require the composite-key implementation to keep them separate. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.textEn: Use ARCHER2’s logical-to-physical topology to audit whether sixteen worker threads occupy sixteen physical cores. Distinct logical CPU identifiers do not by themselves establish distinct compute resources.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍

knowledge.textEn: Map logical CPUs to composite socket-and-core keys, then divide unique physical cores by the target count. Deduplicating bare core_id values across sockets can incorrectly merge different cores.

steps.instruction:

在交接件中加入「ARCHER2：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：手算八組兄弟對得到 50%；跨兩個 socket 使用重複 core_id 的邊界測例不得誤合併；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。

Deliver the sibling map, before-and-after assignments, cross-socket deduplication case and an explicit unmapped-CPU error report. State the placement contract independently of any measured speedup.

Emit a per-core worker list and uncovered-core list, preserving logical identifiers so the audit can be traced back to the allocation. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
